usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all Proxmox VE access groups visible to the authenticated token or user. Results are automatically filtered by privilege — only groups where the caller holds 'User.Modify', 'Sys.Audit', or 'Group.Allocate' on /access/groups/<group> are returned, so an empty list does not mean no groups exist. No parameters are required; this is a lightweight read suitable for populating dropdowns or validating group names before assignment.

examples.summary: List all access groups visible to the current token

tips: The 'users' field in each returned object is a comma-separated list in pve-userid-list format (e.g. 'alice@pam,bob@pve'); it may be absent if the group has no members.
A non-admin token will silently see only the groups it has privilege on — always validate with a Sys.Audit-capable token when auditing the full group roster.
Use the returned 'groupid' values directly with create_access_group_role_mapping or delete_access_group to act on a specific group.
